items.summary: Seven Husker innovators have received a combined $133,000 in inaugural Innovation Advancement Fund awards from NUtech Ventures. The recipients — Hamid Bagheri, Steven Barlow, Georgina Bingham, Nipuna Chamara, Tim Gatzenmeier, George Gogos and Harkamal Walia — will use the proof-of-concept funding to advance technologies with commercial potential.

items.title: 'Research and Root Beer Floats' introduces students to undergraduate research
items.summary: The University Honors Program and Office of Undergraduate Research and Fellowships introduced first-year students to research opportunities at Nebraska during a Nov. 19 workshop. Students explored programs and resources for pursuing research across academic disciplines and learned how hands-on experiences can complement classroom learning and prepare them for future careers.
